node.title: Re: multi byte character issue
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: I don't know how MS SQL might interact with the environment variables, but it would still be helpful if you could provide a short, runnable piece of code that you can use to reproduce the error on your end, perhaps we can spot the issue in that (for example, do you use locale; or something similar?). Also, see [id://1233709|my node here] for tips on how to help debug some Unicode issues, in particular, in this case you should use [doc://Devel::Peek]'s Dump to inspect the variable in question (and post that output here too).
